title: The carried low batch
desiredOutcome: Every low review finding carried to BUG-29-dau is fixed in the code, or answered with the evidence that nothing is left to change, and the bug closes

findings.issue: sr39 failed on the windows resample leg of run 40781798399 (c35ffffb): exit 3 in 7.1 s but the basis did not say timed out. The case builds a first run sleeping 3 s under a 7 s deadline, so whether the deadline lands in the second run, in the first, or not at all depends on how fast the runner starts interpreters; on a loaded windows runner the first run can eat the budget.
findings.resolution: Make sr39 independent of runner speed: drive the cut-off with a witness rather than a sleep sized against the deadline (as tt3c in tools/sweep-selftests.py does), so the second run is reached and cut off on any runner; keep the assertion that one deadline covers both runs.

tasks.description: Fix P148-R1 (docs/audit/phases/P148.json review.findings): sr39 in tests/test_stamp_verification.py failed on the windows resample leg because its first run sleeps a fixed time against a fixed deadline. Make it independent of runner speed - e.g. the first run touches a witness and the second blocks until the deadline, or the deadline derived from the measured first run - so that on any runner the second run is reached and cut off, and the case still proves one deadline covers both runs. Prove it red first: the assertion must still fail against a helper that grants each run its own full deadline. Edit only the test file. No F/P/BUG ids in code.
